articles.summary: Experimental in proportion, texture and colour, the collection introduces leather and footwear to Snow Goose by Canada Goose for the first time Today, Canada Goose unveils Axis of Endurance , the Fall/Winter 2026 Snow Goose by Canada Goose collection from Creative Director, Haider Ackermann. The collection launches with a global campaign shot by Julie Joubert, featuring Mariane Godoy​, Samvel Tadevossian, Simon Franck​, Marin Fournier​, Eliot Cassignat and Cesar Salmon. Snow Goose by Canada Goose Fall/Winter 2026 For this season, Ackermann considers endurance as both physical and internal: the quiet tension of staying with something longer than comfort allows, until instinct takes over. The performance heritage of Canada Goose is pushed into a more experimental expression, with outerwear conceived as a protective environment around the body, designed not simply to overcome winter, but to become fluent within it. “There is a silence and a stillness to the campaign this season,” says
articles.title: Haider Ackermann Presents Axis of Endurance, a Study in Strength and Form for Snow Goose by Canada Goose Fall/Winter 2026
